commits.message:
fix(status): a Status message draws its markup (rich-status-o9av) (#267)

* fix(status): a Status message draws its markup (rich-status-o9av)

new Status("[bold]Working[/]") drew the brackets: StatusRenderable yielded
the message as one raw Segment. Status's renderable is now a Spinner whose
label is the message, as Rich's is, and the Spinner's label crosses embed's
EmbeddedText, so a string is markup under the drawing console, assembled
with its frame as Rich's Text.assemble(frame, " ", text). The label is left
unhighlighted, as Rich's Text label is.

Status's `style` is now `spinnerStyle` (Rich's spinner_style, default
status.spinner): the message styles itself with markup, and the rename makes
the changed meaning a type error rather than a silent recolour.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* fix(spinner): the frame is never wrapped apart, the fragment is uncut, and the label is one source (rich-status-o9av)

Review of #267: measure's minimum is floored at the widest frame, so a frame
with spaces in it is never offered less room than itself; drawFrame leaves
its fragment at natural width for the composing caller to cut, while render
wraps the line as Rich's Text does; and the label is held once and read
through EmbeddedText when drawn, so a RichText changed in place draws as
changed and the getter is what is drawn.

---------
